index.html.description: Preview The 7 Minute Phone Call, explore the conversation framework and chapter topics, and check book availability for your sales learning goals.
index.html.heading: Choose a practical starting point for your sales conversations
index.html.body:
Review the conversation framework and chapter topics before deciding whether the book fits your role. Identify the point where your conversations stall and the next step you want to practice.

Use the reading guide to turn the material into a focused exercise, then ask about current book availability. A framework supports preparation; it does not guarantee a sale or a response.
